title: scpPower: calibration, simulation and power for single-cell proteomics
description: scpPower calibrates cell-level noise, acquisition-batch effects and detection parameters from public single-cell proteomics datasets and maps between-donor variance from an independent bulk cohort. It simulates hierarchical protein measurements and estimates power, testability, conditional power, realised false discovery rates and nominal instrument hours for the registered sample-level endpoint. The archive includes the frozen mandate and addenda, registered fidelity and semi-synthetic validation evidence, the complete power grid, worked examples, pilot protocol, manuscript number audit and Supporting Information. Between-donor variance transfer and carrier compression remain declared assumptions. This maintenance version changes no scientific model, preset, endpoint or registered result.
